adjudication.rationale: In `packages/lib/constants.ts`, `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` is defined as `process.env.CALCOM_WEBHOOK_SECRET && process.env.CALCOM_APP_CREDENTIAL_ENCRYPTION_KEY;`. Because env vars are strings, the `&&` expression evaluates to the second string (or `undefined`), not a boolean. This makes the exported constant effectively `string | undefined` (truthy string) rather than a `boolean`, which is an API/type-signature change for consumers and can also misrepresent intent (e.g., downstream code expecting a boolean).
